sentences.en: In spite of our congratulations, he frowned and turned away.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们向他表示祝贺，但他皱起眉头转身离开了。

sentences.en: He took off his glasses and frowned at the nurse.
sentences.zh: 他摘下眼镜，皱着眉看着护士。

sentences.en: Mr Yamada frowned on the estimate presented by a travel agency.
sentences.zh: 山田先生对旅行社提供的报价表示反对。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：f（音似：翻）+row（看作brow眉毛，额头）+n→翻眉毛→皱眉
